item.title: Indian Artefacts Among 600+ Items Stolen From Bristol Museum; CCTV Images Released
item.description: Over 600 artefacts, including items from India, were stolen from a Bristol Museum building in the UK.Police have released CCTV images of four suspects involved in the September 25 break-in.

item.title: DGCA Suspends Four Flight Operation Inspectors After Massive IndiGo Flight Cancellations
item.description: DGCA has suspended four flight operation inspectors following widespread IndiGo flight cancellations across India, ahead of the airline CEO’s meeting with the aviation regulator.

item.title: KMC sets Dec 14 deadline for cleaning vacant sites
item.description: Commissioner says four key sanitation initiatives are being implemented with public participationCautions that all vacant site owners must voluntarily clear their plots by December 14Of the 325 identified vacant sites, notices were issued to 182 owners while the remaining 143 could not be traced

item.title: Dead Candidate Wins Telangana Sarpanch Election After Heart Attack; Ballot Still Carried His Name
item.description: A deceased candidate, BRS-supported Cherla Murali, won the sarpanch election in Chintala Tana, Telangana, after his name stayed on the ballot following his sudden death. Villagers voted for him as a tribute, prompting officials to review the next steps for the vacant post.
